_: Config for scripts/auto-qa-tuner.mjs (ACMM acmm:auto-qa-tuning, saiku#2123). The tuner reads measured test/coverage data and PROPOSES ratchet bumps as a report. It never edits .github/test-floors.json or .coverage-thresholds.json and is not a CI gate; a human applies any bump in a normal PR.

testFloorHeadroom._: Propose raising a test-count floor when measured total exceeds floor by more than minHeadroomTests. Proposed floor = measured - keepHeadroomTests, so ordinary churn does not trip the gate.

coverageHeadroom._: Propose raising a JaCoCo line-coverage floor (percent) when measured coverage exceeds floor by more than minHeadroomPercent. Proposed floor = floor(measured) - keepHeadroomPercent.

flakyTests._: Report testcases whose surefire XML carries flakyFailure/flakyError/rerunFailure/rerunError elements (surefire rerunFailingTestsCount). Report-only: flaky tests should be fixed, not floored.
